abstract.text: Parse, process and display text in Markdown format.
provides functionality for converting Markdown blocks into
objects that are used in macOS and iOS for displaying rich text.
The implementation is extensible allowing subclasses of
override how individual Markdown structures are converted into attributed strings.
A SwiftUI view that displays a Markdown document as formatted text. The view converts the
document into an attributed string with an
generators for light and dark mode, and shows the result in a read-only text view whose text
can be selected. The view scrolls vertically.
